notes: The verse analysed one construction two ways: `כִּי` rendered by a coordinator plus *though* was headed on the coordinator at s006 (*for*) and on the subordinator at s028 (*though*). Rule 55's head directive is written for a waw, whose own nature is coordinating; where the written connective is itself a subordinator, rule 24 puts the head on the word realizing its lexeme, which the bare `כִּי` -> *though* of this same verse identifies. Head of the s006 unit moved from t008 to t009; no edge changed.
